headline: Three-Year-Old Hospitalised After Sexual Assault in Goa
summary: A three-year-old girl has been hospitalised following a sexual assault in Goa. In response to the incident, a state minister stated that outsiders are responsible for 90 percent of such crimes.

headline: Police Arrest Accused in Minor Sexual Assault Cases
summary: Goa Police have arrested suspects involved in the alleged sexual assault of minor girls in Mapusa and Canacona. Investigations are currently ongoing across both jurisdictions.

headline: Driving to Goa for a Quick Recharging Getaway
summary: A traveller details a road trip to Goa in a Mahindra Scorpio taken to relax and unwind. The account highlights driving experiences and scenic travel routes.

headline: Common Time Opens First Brunch House in Goa
summary: Hospitality brand Common Time has launched its first dedicated brunch house in Goa. The new outlet aims to expand dining options for both locals and visiting tourists.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express to Launch on November 15
summary: A new Vande Bharat Express train connecting Bengaluru and Goa via coastal towns like Mangaluru and Gokarna has been approved. Regular operations for the service are set to begin on November 15.

headline: Karnataka Native Arrested in Mapusa Child Assault Case
summary: Goa Police have solved the sexual assault case involving a child in Mapusa. A native of Karnataka has been taken into custody in connection with the crime.

headline: Four-Year-Old Assaulted in Second Recent Child Abuse Case
summary: A four-year-old girl was sexually assaulted in Goa, marking the second such incident reported within a single week. Authorities are currently investigating the matter.

headline: CREDAI-Goa Demands Faster Approvals for Real Estate Projects
summary: Real estate body CREDAI-Goa has urged authorities to expedite project approvals, citing delays of up to six months. Developers state these bureaucratic hold-ups are severely affecting project timelines.

headline: Goa StCB to Integrate IMPS, UPI, and Net Banking Services
summary: The Goa State Cooperative Bank (StCB) is working to integrate digital payment platforms including IMPS, UPI, and Net Banking. The initiative aims to modernize financial transactions for its customer base.

headline: Two Arrested in Separate Assault Cases Involving Minors
summary: Goa Police have apprehended two men in connection with two separate sexual assault cases involving minors. The arrests follow intensified local enforcement efforts.

headline: Experts Warn Goa's Rivers and Wetlands Face Ecological Collapse
summary: Environmental concerns have been raised regarding the critical state of Goa's rivers and wetlands. Reports indicate these ecosystems are on the verge of severe ecological collapse.

headline: Bihar Native Arrested in Four-Year-Old's Assault Case
summary: A native of Bihar has been arrested following the sexual assault of a four-year-old girl in Goa. This marks the second child assault case reported in the state within a week.

headline: Second Child Assault Incident Reported in Goa Within a Week
summary: Authorities have reported a second child sexual assault case in Goa within seven days. A suspect originally from Bihar has been taken into custody.

headline: Manoj Parab Set to Rejoin Revolutionary Goans Party on Nov 22
summary: Politician Manoj Parab is scheduled to formally rejoin the Revolutionary Goans Party on November 22. The move marks a significant development in the state's political landscape.

headline: Higher Fares Noted on Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Route
summary: Passengers on the Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express are paying around ₹200 more compared to similar distances on other routes. The fare difference has raised concerns among regular rail commuters.

headline: Tillari Canal Repair Work Postponed Until 2027
summary: The government has deferred planned repair work on the second Tillari canal until the year 2027. The postponement affects ongoing maintenance schedules for regional water infrastructure.

headline: Margao Fish Market Flagged for Sanitation and Safety Violations
summary: Inspecting authorities have cited the Margao fish market for multiple safety and sanitation compliance failures. Officials are expecting prompt corrective measures to ensure public health.

headline: Four Injured and Vehicles Destroyed in Assagao Shop Fire
summary: A major fire at a shop in Assagao left four people injured and destroyed four vehicles. Emergency personnel responded to extinguish the blaze and assist victims.

headline: CCTV Coverage Gaps Delay Investigation into Mapusa Toddler Assault
summary: Police investigating the sexual assault of a toddler in Mapusa are facing challenges due to gaps in local CCTV coverage. Authorities are working to gather alternate evidence to solve the case.

headline: Ration Cards Temporarily Suspended, Not Cancelled, Clarifies Department
summary: The Civil Supplies Department clarified that affected ration cards have been temporarily suspended rather than permanently cancelled. Cardholders are advised to complete necessary verification procedures.

headline: Sunil Chhetri Joins FIFA's Player Impact Programme
summary: Indian football captain Sunil Chhetri has become the first male player selected for FIFA's Player Impact Programme. The initiative highlights significant contributions to football development and community impact.

headline: Kadamba Transport Corporation Workers Defer November 12 Strike
summary: Workers at the Kadamba Transport Corporation (KTC) have postponed their planned strike previously scheduled for November 12. Public transport services are expected to run as scheduled.

headline: Navelim College Launches 'Digital Saathi' Camp for Senior Citizens
summary: A college in Navelim has introduced the 'Digital Saathi' initiative aimed at training senior citizens in digital literacy. The program focuses on empowering older adults to navigate modern technology comfortably.

headline: Mapusa Child Assault Solved with Arrest of Karnataka Native
summary: Goa Police successfully tracked down and arrested a Karnataka native involved in the Mapusa child assault case. Law enforcement officials confirmed the arrest after completing preliminary investigations.

headline: Goa Includes Transgender Community in State OBC List
summary: The Goa government has officially included the transgender community in the state's Other Backward Classes (OBC) list. The decision aims to provide social welfare benefits and official recognition.

headline: PM Modi Likely to Flag Off Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to flag off the new Vande Bharat train service connecting Bengaluru, coastal Karnataka, and Goa. The service aims to improve interstate connectivity and travel time.

headline: Route Guide for the 540 km Drive from Arambol to Mumbai
summary: A travel summary outlines road conditions and tips for driving the 540 km route between Arambol in Goa and Mumbai. The guide offers insights for long-distance motorists.

headline: Police Search for Suspect After Assault of Three-Year-Old
summary: Goa Police have launched a manhunt to locate an unknown suspect who sexually assaulted a three-year-old girl inside an abandoned building. Security teams are scouring nearby areas for leads.

headline: Quiet Arabian Sea Stretch Highlighted as Alternative Destination
summary: A travel report highlights a peaceful stretch along the Arabian Sea as an alternative to crowded spots like Goa and the Maldives. The destination offers visitors a relaxed and unhurried getaway.

headline: Clean-Up at SGPDA Market Highlighted by Ongoing Civic Issues
summary: Recent clean-up attempts at the SGPDA market have failed to address underlying infrastructural and hygiene problems. Vendors and visitors continue to express frustration over persistent civic neglect.

headline: Goa Olympic Association Sending Two Athletes to Macau
summary: The Goa Olympic Association (GOA) has announced that two athletes will represent the state at an upcoming event in Macau. The selected athletes are preparing for their international participation.

headline: Palolem Beach Named Asia's Top Beach for 2026
summary: Palolem Beach in South Goa has been ranked as Asia's top beach for 2026 and sixth globally. The accolade highlights its pristine shores and popularity among global travelers.

headline: Margao Railway Station Set for Major Facility Upgrade
summary: Margao railway station is scheduled to undergo a comprehensive infrastructure upgrade to improve passenger amenities. Plans include modernizing facilities and enhancing crowd management.

headline: New Vande Bharat Express Route Draws Mixed Reactions
summary: While the new Vande Bharat Express route is welcomed by commuters in Mangaluru, travel times to Goa are being viewed as overly long. Commuters have called for schedule adjustments.

headline: Regular Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Service Starts November 15
summary: Regular operations for the Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express will officially commence on November 15. The service will run multiple days a week to accommodate intercity travel.

headline: Opposition Criticizes Ministership for Sankalp Amonkar
summary: Opposition parties in Goa have raised strong objections to former Congress leader Sankalp Amonkar's appointment as a state minister. Critics label the political move as opportunistic political maneuvering.

headline: Mobile Unit Deployed in Panaji After Post-Diwali AQI Spikes
summary: A mobile air quality monitoring unit has been deployed in Panaji after post-Diwali AQI levels reached 155. Authorities are tracking pollution levels to assess local air quality impacts.

headline: Event Guide Released for IFFI Goa 2026
summary: An insider guide outlines key events, screenings, and cultural experiences planned for the upcoming International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa. The festival features diverse global cinema and workshops.

headline: GSCERT to Review Grade I & II Performance in Common Exam
summary: The Goa State Council of Educational Research and Training (GSCERT) will analyze student performance following the first common examination for Grades I and II. The assessment aims to improve early learning outcomes.

headline: Minister Attributes Child Assault Crimes to Outsiders Following Incident
summary: Following the assault of a four-year-old girl in Goa, a minister claimed that 90 percent of such offenses are committed by outsiders. The comments have triggered wider discussions on safety enforcement.

headline: BJP Accuses Congress of Mixing Festive Celebrations with Politics
summary: The BJP in Goa has accused the Congress party of indulging in appeasement politics during Diwali celebrations. Congress leaders have denied the allegations, calling them politically motivated.

headline: Poultry Associations Seek Government Aid to Increase Production
summary: Industry representatives from Goa's poultry sector have requested financial and policy support from the government to boost domestic egg and meat production. The move aims to address local supply demands.

headline: Child Rights Panel Calls for Stronger Safety Mechanisms in Goa
summary: Goa's child rights commission has called for an urgent strengthening of protection systems following recent crimes against minors. The panel urged multi-agency coordination to safeguard children.

headline: Calangute Police Halt Krishna Vijay Utsav Due to Lack of Permits
summary: Police in Calangute stopped the organized Krishna Vijay Utsav event due to missing official permits and safety approvals. Organizers were asked to secure necessary permissions before proceeding.

headline: Manoj Parab Scheduled to Return to RGP Leadership
summary: Former Revolutionary Goans Party president Manoj Parab is set to rejoin the party leadership on November 22. Supporters are preparing for his formal re-entry event.

headline: Woman Succumbs to Injuries After Scooter Accident in Mandrem
summary: A woman involved in a scooter crash in Mandrem has passed away from her injuries several days after the incident. Police have registered a case to investigate the road accident.

headline: Twelve Men Arrested for Operating Multi-Crore Scam from Goa Villa
summary: Authorities uncovered a multi-crore financial fraud operated by 12 young men renting a luxury villa in Goa. Police seized digital equipment and financial records during the raid.

headline: Two Brothers Defrauded of Rs 12 Lakh in Employment Scam
summary: Two brothers in Goa were cheated of Rs 12 lakh after falling victim to an online job offer scam. Police have registered a fraud complaint and initiated an investigation.

headline: Palolem Beach Ranked 6th Worldwide in Top Beaches List
summary: Palolem Beach has earned sixth place in a global ranking of the top 25 beaches worldwide. The recognition highlights the beach's global popularity and natural scenery.

headline: GFP Demands Police Audit and All-Women Police Stations
summary: The Goa Forward Party (GFP) has demanded a comprehensive police performance audit along with all-women police stations in every taluka. The proposal aims to enhance public safety and protect women.
